findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.citation_text:
2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a Certified FOOD Protection Manager (CFPM) who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

On inspector arrival there was not a CFPM available at the facility. Staff at the time of the inspection indicated that the manager on duty had gone to another location to open there and would be back shortly. Mr. Annerino arrived during the inspection to correct the violation. Ensure that there are enough CFPMs available to cover all shifts in an emergency.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.12(B) Cleaning Procedure. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use the following cleaning procedure in the order stated to clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms, including surrogate prosthetic devices for hands and arms: (5) Immediately follow the cleaning procedure with thorough drying using a method as specified under § 6-301.12. 

An employee was observed to wash their hands and then use their bare hands to turn off the faucet, thus recontaminating their hands. Education was conducted with the PIC and they are instructed to review hand washing procedures with staff and monitor hand washing as needed to ensure that all hand washing procedures are conducted safely at all times moving forward.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
(REPEAT x3) 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

1) Two of the slicers under the counter in the back prep area were observed with food debris remaining on them. They appeared to have been stored without proper cleaning. The PIC was shown and instructed to clean the food contact items within four hours of use. 2) (REPEAT x3) Soda nozzles in the drive thru area customer service area were observed soiled. The PIC was shown and instructed to clean them. The food contact surfaces were cleaned during this inspection to correct the immediate situation. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are maintained clean at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.citation_text:
6-202.15(A) Outer Openings, Protected. (A) Outer openings of a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by: (1) Filling or closing holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings; (2) Closed, tight-fitting windows; and (3) Solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors. 

There was an observed gap allowing light to enter through the bottom of the back door into the facility. This is an obvious possible pest entrance and should be repaired/resealed prior to the next routine inspection to prevent these possible pests. Ensure that all outer openings are sealed at all times.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.111(C) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (C) Using methods, if pests are found, such as trapping devices or other means of pest control as specified under §§ 7-202.12, 7-206.12, and 7-206.13.

Several fruit/drain flies were observed in the facility during the inspection. At the time of the inspection a large amount of the flies were observed in the dry storage room specifically around the mops and dump sink. The violation is NOT considered corrected at the time of the inspection and the PIC is instructed to continue working with their pest control agency for remedial action. The follow-up is being scheduled for one month to allow for remedial action to take effect.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.citation_text:
3-302.11(A)(2) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (2) Except when combined as ingredients, separating types of raw animal FOODS from each other such as beef, FISH, lamb, pork, and POULTRY during storage, preparation, holding, and display.

Raw eggs were observed stored over ready to eat foods on wire shelves in the walk in cooler. The PIC was shown and the eggs moved to correct. Ensure that all foods are stored according to their cooking temperatures in the facility at all times.

(REPEAT x2) 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The soda nozzles in the drive thru area are observed soiled. The PIC was shown and instructed to clean them. findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.111(C) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (C) Using methods, if pests are found, such as trapping devices or other means of pest control as specified under §§ 7-202.12, 7-206.12, and 7-206.13.

Several fruit/drain flies were observed in the facility during the inspection. The majority of the observed pests were in the back storage room but they were sighted throughout the facility in smaller numbers as well. Per the PIC they were aware of the issue and had a company out to out stuff down the drains. They have also been spraying a chemical throughout the facility before opening each morning. This is a good start and should be continued. Ensure that pest control is maintained and the pests are removed from the facility prior to the follow up.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.110 Using Dressing Rooms and Lockers. (A) Dressing rooms shall be used by EMPLOYEES if the EMPLOYEES regularly change their clothes in the establishment. (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be used for the orderly storage of EMPLOYEE clothing and other possessions. 

1) A monster energy drink was observed in the standing cooler next to the prep line alongside foods intended for consumers. 2) (REPEAT) A phone was observed on the table in the back next to equipment and with food nearby. The situations were discussed with the PIC and they are instructed to ensure that all employee personal items are stored so that they do not pose a concern for contamination of consumer foods. Ensure that all personal items are stored away from food contact and preparation areas to prevent possible contamination of foods.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).

2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a Certified FOOD Protection Manager (CFPM) who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

There was not a CFPM available at the time that the inspection began. The PIC at the time stated that the CFPM was at the other store picking up supplies. About halfway through the inspection Mr. Annerino arrived. This corrected the violation but a CFPM must be present at all times that the facility is operating.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored.
findings.citation_text:
3-304.14(B) Wiping Cloths, Use Limitation. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and other EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be: (1) Held between uses in a chemical sanitizer solution at a concentration specified under § 4-501.114; and (2) Laundered daily as specified under 4-802.11(D).

During the inspection a moist wiping cloth was observed on a counter and not in current use. The PIC was consulted once they arrived and the cloth moved to a sani bucket to correct. Ensure that all wiping rags are stored between uses in a sanitizer at effective concentration.

findings.citation_text:
4-303.11(B) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

On arrival there was not a sanitizer prepared and ready for use. A solution was prepared during this inspection to correct. Ensure that sanitizers are available for use in the facility at all times that foods and food contact surfaces are handled.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.citation_text:
2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a Certified FOOD Protection Manager (CFPM) who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

The CFPM at the beginning of the inspection needed to leave without a replacement CFPM available to cover the shift. They stated that the night manager was in the process of trying for the certification but had not yet attained it. Ensure that there is always at least 1 CFPM present during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and:(H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD; and (I) After engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

1) Employees are observed to don gloves without washing hands. 2) An employee was observed to adjust their pants and then don gloves and handle food without hand washing. Education was conducted with the PIC and they are instructed to ensure that when to conduct hand washing is reviewed with staff and enforced in the facility. Ensure hand washing is taking place prior to donning gloves and at any time that hands may have become contaminated prior to food handling.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.citation_text:
4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

A crate in the walk in cooler used to store a sauce container off of the floor is observed with major white mold growth on it. The PIC was shown and removed the item for cleaning. Ensure that all non-food contact surfaces are maintained clean in the facility at all times.

findings.comment: The triple sink’s faucet was observed leaking water into the sink basin. Ensure that the faucet is maintained in good repair and in leak free condition.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(B) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: Inspector observed a bag of raw unwashed onions to be hanging over a bucket of cooled refried beans in the walk in cooler. The beans were not covered with a lid. Properly protect the refried beans. Container of beans were moved and a lid was added to the container. The violation is considered corrected on site. 
 
(A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The following areas of the facility are soiled with dust and/or food crumbs: 1) shelf under iced side of prep table 2) shelf under prep table in the cook ing area 3) fans of the walk in cooler and area right above the fans on the ceiling. 
Clean and maintain these areas free of accumulated soil.

(A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
